card.name: Code and credit lines before text
card.fires_on: Short joining marks or words right before a quoted string or name in web and code text, such as an opening quote or parenthesis after a function, or "by" in a site credit. Also the end of path names like hgfs.

modes.label: Opening quote in code
modes.description: An opening parenthesis or quote right after a function or command, before a literal string.

modes.label: Site credit "by"
modes.description: The word by in a design or authorship credit at the end of a page.

modes.label: Path or config name ending
modes.description: The last piece of a file path or configuration keyword.

card.writes: It seems to push toward tutorial-style words, with no clear link to the text shown.
card.plain: It fires on small joining marks in programming examples and web page credits, not on medical content.
